public_copy.official_check: SUMMIT minor policy checked October 10, 2026: visitors under 16 must stay with an adult throughout the visit. Do not assume an older teen qualifies as the required adult. SUMMIT and SPYSCAPE use exact tickets with different effects, durations, and minor rules. Choose the product before comparing the price.
public_copy.faq: SUMMIT requires visitors under 16 to stay with an adult throughout the visit (policy checked October 10, 2026). A 13-year-old therefore needs an adult; these sources do not establish whether a 17-year-old qualifies as that adult or whether older teens can enter independently. Elsewhere, check the exact venue's minor rule and your family's supervision plan. This guide makes no independent-roaming or safety assurances.
